T:P1.4.text: World Leader In Industrial Process Heating

T:P1.6.text: Learn from Thermon engineers and product experts. Explore live sessions, visit us at industry events, or watch on-demand.

T:P1.7.text: From electric heat tracing to explosion-proof heaters, Thermon delivers engineered thermal solutions across every industry and environment.

T:P1.8.text: Electric heat, immersion, circulation, and specialty heaters for every industrial application.

T:P1.9.text: Electrical heat tracing cables, steam trace products, controls, and monitoring systems.

T:P1.10.text: Explosion-proof and rugged heating solutions engineered for the harshest transportation environments.

T:P1.11.text: General purpose and hazardous location power distribution panels and accessories for project sites.

T:P1.12.text: Electrically heated, steam, and pre-insulated tubing bundles with complete system accessories.

T:P1.13.text: Precision thermal management solutions designed to protect critical data center infrastructure.

T:P1.14.text: Heated flat blankets and container temperature control for custom industrial heating needs.

T:P1.15.text: Steam, hot water, and electrode boilers plus ancillary equipment for precision thermal processes.

T:P1.16.text: High-performance steam, hot oil, and hot water boilers with superheaters and ancillary systems.

T:P1.17.text: Our customers rely on us to provide high quality, safe, reliable and environmentally responsible solutions for their heating needs.

T:P1.18.text: Whether you’re looking for complete flow assurance, industrial heating, temperature maintenance, freeze protection or environmental monitoring, Thermon has you covered.

T:P1.19.text: We proudly celebrate our 70th anniversary! Since our founding in by Richard Burdick, Thermon has been dedicated to innovation in heat transfer solutions.

T:P1.20.text: From introducing heat transfer cement to pioneering the first packaged tracing systems and developing high-performance heating technologies, we’ve consistently pushed the boundaries to meet our customers’ needs

C:P1.2.text: SUPERIOR PIPING SOLUTIONS THAT EXCEED EXPECTATIONS

C:P1.3.text: At PERMA-PIPE International Holdings, Inc., integrity is at the core of everything we do. We deliver durable, high-performance pipe systems that meet the toughest standards while continuously innovating to enhance quality, efficiency, and sustainability.

C:P1.4.text: With expertise in anti-corrosion coatings, insulation solutions, containment systems, custom fabrication, leak detection systems, and comprehensive technical support, field service, and logistics, we’re ready to be your trusted partner in piping system solutions.

C:P1.5.text: Let’s build the future of pipe systems—together.

C:P1.6.text: Supporting the Industries That Keep the World Moving

C:P1.7.text: Efficient Energy Distribution District energy systems use pre-insulated piping to transport steam, hot water, and chilled water, providing reliable heating and cooling for commercial and industrial sites. They optimize performance, reduce costs, and enhance energy efficiency and sustainability at scale.

C:P1.8.text: Reliable Piping Solutions From energy production to essential manufacturing, the energy and industrial sector drives modern economies and demands safe, reliable transport solutions. PERMA-PIPE’s pre-insulated piping and containment systems provide robust, end-to-end sealing to prevent corrosion and ensure long-lasting durability.

C:P1.9.text: Essential Mining Solutions Reliable piping is essential for transporting water, slurry, chemicals, and gases in demanding mining conditions. Pre-insulated pipes offer a durable solution, protecting against damage, optimizing energy efficiency, and enhancing safety. Ideal for harsh climates and remote locations, they ensure long-term performance in extreme environments.

C:P1.10.text: The Solutions You Can Rely On.

C:P1.11.text: We deliver high-performance insulation solutions, reliable containment systems, top-tier anti-corrosion coatings, custom fabrication, and advanced leak detection technology. Trusted worldwide, our solutions go beyond materials—we collaborate with customers to create customized piping systems that exceed project requirements. With a focus on precision, reliability, and innovation, we tackle even the most complex challenges.

C:P1.12.text: PERMA-PIPE manufactures and supplies pre-insulated piping solutions, containment systems, anti-corrosion coatings, custom fabrication and leak detection systems, offering products tailored to meet client requirements and specifications. We support you at every stage, providing expert planning, engineering and technical assistance, material consulting, specification guidance, calculations, logistics, and dedicated project management. With a team of experienced professionals, we deliver customized solutions to keep your project on track—no matter the complexity.

C:P1.13.text: Count on us for high-quality products and services crafted to meet your exact requirements.

C:P1.14.text: PERMA-PIPE International Holdings, Inc. is a global leader in engineered pipe services, specializing in anti-corrosion coatings, insulation solutions, containment systems, custom fabrication, leak detection, technical support, field service, and logistics.

C:P2.3.text: At PERMA-PIPE, we pride ourselves on being a worldwide leader in engineered piping solutions. Our expertise spans anti-corrosion coatings, advanced insulation solutions, containment systems, custom fabrication, and cutting-edge leak detection technology.

C:P2.4.text: With decades of industry experience and certifications in ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001, we are committed to delivering reliable, high-performance solutions tailored to the unique demands of every project, no matter how complex.

C:P2.129.text: TYPE FS TYPE FS utilizes any type of product pipe(s) for maximum service pipe integrity inside a fiberglass containment. The Type FS piping system is constructed with both a supply and return line in a single containment for emergency power generation systems. Additional applications include jet hydrants fuels and industrial waste drain piping systems. Options include leak detection and electric heat tracing systems.

C:P3.4.text: At PERMA-PIPE, we go beyond delivering products — we create solutions that redefine industry standards. What sets us apart is our unwavering commitment to innovation, sustainability, and close collaboration with our customers. We develop systems customized to meet even the most complex piping requirements, from extreme high-temperature environments to cryogenic conditions.
